ATLANTA


, Nov. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ ), a leading global provider of exchange-traded funds (ETFs), announced today that it expects to deliver capital gains distributions to the following Invesco ETFs.1


For the funds listed in the Table, the ex-date for the 2026 capital gains distributions will be Monday, December 21, 2026. The record date will be Monday, December 21, 2026, and the payable date will be Monday, December 28, 2026.
